bsi.editorial_reason: The Hebrew 'erez in Leviticus 14:4 and Numbers 19:6 denotes cedar wood broadly, and specialist translators permit Phoenician juniper as one candidate in ritual contexts; it does not establish the exact modern species. Jeremiah 17:6 and 48:6 use separate 'ar'ar words for a dry-land bush/juniper. Preserve both independently attested lexical groups, but remove false certainty from the editorial species label, without changing the original Bible words, references or anatomical identification.
editorial_evidence: Pinned WLC Lev 14:4 o030140040101 and Num 19:6 o040190060041 are אֶרֶז (cedar wood)
Pinned WLC Jer 17:6 o240170060022 עַרְעָר and Jer 48:6 o240480060052 עֲרוֹעֵר are the separate bush words

UBS translators' botanical reference explicitly allows Phoenician juniper for Hebrew 'erez but does not restrict every occurrence: https://tips.translation.bible/story/phoenician-juniper-coastal-juniper/
